attributes.action: Ban the sale of all non silent fireworks to prevent stress to pets and wildlife.
attributes.background: Ban the sale of all non-silent fireworks to prevent stress to pets and wildlife. Make them illegal for sale and enforce fines for anyone breaking this law. Pets and their owners are suffering un-due stress and vet fees due to the sale of these. Wildlife does not have a choice. Act now.

rejection.details:
We have a petition that has opened very recently which calls for what your petition is seeking. You may wish to sign it.

Ban all loud fireworks and only allow silent ones to be sold in the UK
https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/786349
